findings.finding_text: Compensation bracket: a throwing log sink on the memgate-compensate emit skips revocation entirely, and a throw on the compensation-failed emit replaces the original delivery error — stranded live key plus INV-MG-2 violation.
findings.label: HIGH
findings.rationale: Merged blind-HIGH + edge-MED; emit faults must never gate the revocation nor mask the rethrown original.

findings.finding_text: Post-delivery faults (capture read, revoke write, verify read) have no compensation bracket; a ledger fault after successful delivery strands a live delivered key with no compensate attempt.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Merged blind+edge; the stranded-key posture must cover the whole post-delivery tail.

findings.finding_text: Post-state-write emits (mint, capture, revoke, verify-revoked, grant) are unguarded: a throwing sink converts completed state into untyped errors and can strand an issuance row whose material is never returned.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Best-effort emit posture (emitCredentialLinkBestEffort analog) for all non-deliver events; deliver's state emit stays strict (the discrimination seam).

findings.finding_text: forwardScoped never rechecks revocation or expiry — verify-then-forward TOCTOU forwards with a dead key.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Caller-verified principal is the registered rev-3 pin; revocation/expiry recheck at forward time is not covered by it.

findings.finding_text: listAgentTokens returns revoked tokens despite the 'live' docstring and aborts the whole listing on one corrupt claims_json row.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Merged blind+edge+auditor: filter revoked, per-row corrupt-row skip, docstring stays truthful.

findings.finding_text: Agent tokens are immortal: no expiry input, no ceiling, null expiry skipped at verify — the longer-lived credential class has a strictly weaker bound than per-run keys.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Add admin-supplied optional expiresAtMs honored at verify; revocation remains the primary bound (story letter silent, hardening unambiguous).

findings.finding_text: deliverRunKey bypasses assertDeliveryTargetSafe — the exported write choke point performs no target-grammar gate; arbitrary-path write incl. traversal.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Merged blind+edge: gate at the single write site so every caller inherits it (AC1 ordering).

findings.finding_text: Delivered env pair written unvalidated: newline/= in caller-supplied gatewayUrl injects extra env entries; no mgrun- prefix check lets an mgat token be delivered as QDS_KG_RECALL_KEY (AC6 structural barrier missing).
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Merged edge+auditor: URL grammar check + keyMaterial prefix guard + negative-control test.

findings.finding_text: memgateDeps ignores opts.env for ledger resolution — resolveMemgateLedgerPath reads process.env directly, reintroducing the stray-default-open at the injection seam.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Thread the injected env through resolveMemgateLedgerPath.

findings.finding_text: Non-string method/path crashes verifyRequest with a raw TypeError instead of a closed-set refusal.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: typeof guards refusing scope-verb (route cannot map).

findings.finding_text: Concurrent double-revoke hits the revocation PK constraint and is mislabeled ledger-unwritable instead of already-gone; SQLITE_BUSY/FULL likewise mislabeled.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: UNIQUE-constraint catch returns already-gone semantics.

findings.finding_text: openReadOnly attach re-opens by path after the inode compare with no post-attach re-check — swap window remains; schema assert is table-name-only.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Merged edge+blind: post-attach statSync inode recheck closes the window.

findings.finding_text: verifyRequest trusts claims_json shape — a crafted row with verbs beyond the granted set verifies at the authz decision; AC2's structural guarantee holds only at mint.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Re-validate claims through the zod scope schemas at verify; invalid claims refuse fail-closed as unknown-key.

findings.finding_text: memgate-refused events carry reason values outside the closed 8-member set (mint-invalid-scope, env-file-invalid, grant-*), violating the Observability Contract M2.3's battery parses.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Auditor: admin/mint typed errors log plain lines with code, not memgate-refused; the event reason field stays closed.

findings.finding_text: Verifier discards the forwardScoped promise (unhandled rejection can print M21 E2E OK past a failed forward).
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Await inside the step framing.

findings.finding_text: ttlRemainingMs emits 0 at the exact expiry boundary, violating the 'absent, never 0' pin (negative values are a pinned deliberate elapsed-style semantic).
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Zero maps to absent; negative stays (test-pinned).

findings.finding_text: Hand-built deps with empty-string signing/admin keys pass undefined-only checks — HMAC under empty key is forgeable; admin compares empty to itself.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Falsy guards at the key seams.

findings.finding_text: Injected now() returning NaN mints an immortal key (NaN expiry binds as NULL).
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Finite clock check at mint.

findings.finding_text: runId is any non-empty string — unbounded length/charset persisted and logged.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: 256-char cap + safe charset (suite fixtures comply).

findings.finding_text: Ledger constructor can throw raw fs errors (unguarded statSync, exclusive-create proof outside the posture try) instead of closed-set ledger-unwritable.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Merged edge+blind: wrap the proof path.

findings.finding_text: A failed writable ledger open leaves an empty 0600 file behind; the next read refuses with schema-absent, converting a transient fault into a persistent-looking state.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Unlink on the failed-open path.

findings.finding_text: recordRevocation stamps Date.now() — revocation timestamps are not injectable under the frozen test clock.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Optional injectable clock on the ledger.

findings.finding_text: forwardScoped forwards unvalidated bodies: NaN/Infinity limit reaches client.recall; retain content unbounded; optional() silently coerces non-string queries into unfiltered reflects.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Merged blind+edge: strict field validation + size cap.

findings.finding_text: Transport-level forward failures emit no memgate-* event — audit trail shows an authorized verify then silence for a failed forward.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Best-effort forward-error emit.

findings.finding_text: GrantAgentTokenInput.name accepted but never persisted; MEMGATE_ENV_FILE exported with no consumer.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Persist name in claims; wire MEMGATE_ENV_FILE as the lifecycle's default target.

findings.finding_text: revokeAgentToken delegates to revokeRunMemoryKey and will revoke per-run tokens with no kind check.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Kind check with a typed refusal.

findings.finding_text: Event names memgate-compensation-failed and memgate-grant are unregistered additions to the 7-event observability list.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Register note in the story Dev Agent Record (additive observability; memgate-forward already adjudicated rev-3(d)).

findings.finding_text: assertDeliveryTargetSafe remediation text contradicts the relative-path KEY_ENV_FILE discipline.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Message-only fix.

findings.finding_text: The delivered env file retains revoked key material after the lifecycle returns; a corpus of dead plaintext credentials accumulates on hosts.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: By-design mirror posture: the env file must live through the run it serves; post-run cleanup belongs to box teardown (DF2.5 lineage), outside this module's surface — deferred to the teardown-owning story.

findings.finding_text: Append-only is trigger-only; DROP TABLE by a process holding the file bypasses it.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Matches the repo-wide audit link-store posture (no defensive pragma there either); a hostile process with 0600 file access is outside the module's threat model — fs perms are the boundary.

findings.finding_text: Verifier hand-rolls mint→deliver→…→revoke instead of calling runMemoryKeyLifecycle, so the exported composition is not what the gate exercises.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: The DoD loop requires the scoped recall BETWEEN deliver and revoke, which the lifecycle's ordering cannot express; compensation ordering is proven by the 20-test lifecycle suite the same gate runs.
